subject: Model provider exhaustion as a timed lease, not retryable cooldown churn

body.observed_state: Claude reported session/five-hour exhaustion before tokens; the user-facing provider surface gives a 02:50 America/Chicago reset. The supervisor now classifies the exhaustion correctly and keeps Codex/mesh running.
promotion_rule: When a provider supplies a reset timestamp, store provider_state=exhausted with cooldown_until=<that timestamp> and remove it from normal admission until expiry.
Do not spawn probe epochs during the lease. At cooldown_until, perform one low-cost capability/receipt-shape probe; only restore ready after a valid witness.
If the provider reports a later reset on probe, extend the same lease rather than increasing failure/cooldown counters.

Ready work carrying preferred_provider=claude must remain ready/leased, not failed, while Claude is exhausted; allow compatible work to route to Codex/native only when provider-affinity/avoid-provider rules permit.
Expose provider exhaustion separately from task failure in heartbeat and receipts so WorkGraph does not learn a false task non-cause from provider quota.
body.regression_fence: No more repeated 3-4 second Claude epochs before the declared reset; provider exhaustion must not consume task retry budget.
